# Sebin P Johnson

> Engineering Manager, AI at Magnit Global. Self-taught generalist architect
> with 9+ years across legacy migrations, Kafka streaming, data pipelines,
> mobile and web development, crawlers and automation, and AI in production.
> If it runs on computers, he can build it, fix it, or scale it. Based in
> Kerala, India, working remotely.

This is a single-page portfolio told in reverse chronology — it opens at the
present and walks the career backwards to where it began: Maggi (Magnit's
GenAI companion for contingent workforce management — LLM orchestration, RAG
over pgvector — built by his team of eleven); Magnit data infrastructure
(2021–2023: near-zero-downtime Oracle→Postgres migration via Kafka + Debezium,
the "Data Ocean" OLAP warehouse); WillHire (lead full-stack, acquired by PRO
Unlimited / Magnit in 2021); PSCTalks (client app shipped as its initial solo
developer, now maintained by a full team, 500k+ downloads, 4.6★); Edstem
Technologies (2017–2021, junior → lead, built a WhatsApp Web automation
interface before official APIs existed — never shipped — and migrated a legacy
Java monolith to Node.js microservices on Kubernetes); and finally the
self-taught origins in Kerala that all of it was climbed from.
